betterCitation: Jack Kerouac, On the Road, Part Three, ch. 5, closing sentence (Sal Paradise)
reason: The verifier could not reach a primary copy; I could, through Internet Archive full-text search restricted to Kerouac’s own books (onroad0000jack_h0n9, onroad00kero_1, onroad00kero_2, onroadpenguintwe0000jack and eleven more scans of the Viking/Penguin text). Every scan reads “…corner of 27th and Federal. Our battered suitcases were piled on the sidewalk again; we had longer ways to go. But no matter, the road is life.” and the next word in each is the chapter number 6 (“Now we had a number of circumstances…”), so the sentence closes chapter 5 of Part Three, which LitCharts, SparkNotes and Wikiquote also give. Narrator Sal Paradise is named. shipped.js: clean, 0 of 3, not banned. 59-character source line, no dash, Fiction. The only improvement is a sharper locator, offered in betterCitation.
